notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Druid.
description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
